title: (feat) O3-6098: Show today's appointments and visit attribute tags in the current visit summary
body: ## Requirements - [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration. - [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui)) - [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests. ## Summary The current visit summary in the expanded queue table row used to show a hard-coded "Scheduled for today" and an "On time" tag for every patient. This PR replaces both with real data, to hopefully show useful information to whoever is managing the queue: **Today's appointments.** A new "Today's appointments" section replaces the previous "Scheduled for today" text, to give more actionable information than an ambiguous "Scheduled for today" that isn't very helpful. It lists the patient's appointments for today from `POST /appointments/search`, one line per appointment: > Checked in · General Medicine at 11:00 AM with Ali Khan +2 providers - Hovering over "+N providers" shows the names of the other providers. Providers removed from the appointment (response `CANCELLED`) and providers without a name are left out, and the names are sorted so the same provider always shows first. - When the patient has no appointments today, the section shows "No appointments scheduled for today". - Nothing is shown while the appointments are loading or if the request fails. - The statuses shown are set by the existing `appointmentStatuses` config, which has been unused since its table was removed in #1729. Its default is now `Scheduled`, `CheckedIn`, `Completed` and `Missed`, and it is validated against the appointment statuses the backend supports. **Visit attribute tags.** The tags next to the visit type now come from the visit's attributes, in the same way as the visit attribute tags in the patient chart banner. A new `visitAttributeTypes` config lists the attribute types to show, and defaults to the Punctuality and Insurance Policy Number types from the reference application demo data. So the punctuality entered in the start visit form now shows here as "On time", "Late" or "Early". The visit custom representation now requests `attributeType.datatypeClassname` so the values can be formatted by datatype (concept, date, or text). ## Screenshots When there are no appointments to show - With multiple appointments that have multiple providers - ## Related Issue [https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-6098](https://openmrs.atlassian.net/browse/O3-6098) ## Other Implementations that still set `appointmentStatuses` from the old scheduled appointments table will now see those statuses in the current visit summary. Values that are not backend statuses, such as `All`, will now fail config validation.
